description: One customer quote in this shop: doc_no (the Q- number), status, every version with its lines and totals, the job and customer, when it was sent and viewed, and the signer name and signed time once someone has signed. Read only. This is a quote, not an AI line draft (that is quotes.draft).
name: quotes_get

doc_no.description: The shop's quote number. Customers see it as Q- followed by this number.

max_total_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents), or null.

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.

signed_at.description: When the quote was signed, in UTC. Null until then.

signer_name.description: The name typed when the quote was signed. Null until then.

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).
